# KRYIL Infotech Private Limited

> KRYIL Infotech builds production AI systems and data platforms for Indian enterprises,
> deployed inside the customer's own cloud or on-premise infrastructure. Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
> Tagline: "Engineered where it runs."

KRYIL Infotech Private Limited (CIN U62099KA2025PTC201071) is a software engineering company
registered with the Registrar of Companies, Bangalore. We build applied AI systems, the data
platforms underneath them, and our own software products.

We are an early-stage company. We do not publish client logos, case studies, certifications or
partnerships that we do not have. Where a capability is in progress rather than in place, this
file says so.

## Services

- Applied AI engineering: retrieval systems over internal documents, document extraction,
  operational forecasting, computer-vision inspection
- Private and on-premise LLM deployment (client VPC or client-owned hardware)
- Data engineering: pipelines, warehouse modelling, data quality, lineage, governance
- Cloud infrastructure and DevOps in support of the above
- Enterprise application development
- Database administration and data platform operations

## Products

- NextDOOH — cloud digital signage platform for Android displays. Real-time content sync,
  multi-zone layouts, remote device management. https://www.kryil.com/products/nextdooh

## Technology

Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Docker, Kubernetes,
Terraform, AWS, Microsoft Azure, open-weight and hosted large language models,
retrieval-augmented generation, MLOps and model monitoring.

## What we do not do

We are not a UAV or drone manufacturer. We do not build, sell or supply defence systems,
weapons, armed unmanned aircraft, or military hardware of any kind. We hold no DGCA type
certificate and make no airworthiness claims.

We hold no third-party security or quality certifications at this time (no ISO 27001, no
SOC 2). Any such certification will be listed here and on https://www.kryil.com/ only once
it has actually been awarded.
